_readme: Vapi Assistant config-as-code for Etihad One. This mirrors what is live on the connected Vapi account (assistant 'ELC Agent', id f44cf5c8-a491-4afd-9dd2-407c224e3774) as of the ELC intelligence-upgrade pass (reasoning loop, tool-vs-transfer discipline, emotional intelligence, error recovery). Replace REPLACE_WITH_VAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET with the real shared secret before importing/patching. The transferCall destination number is a real business config value (the designated human escalation contact), not a secret.
name: ELC Agent
firstMessage: أهلاً بك، معك الاتحاد المحدودة للشحن من الصين إلى عُمان. تفضل، كيف أقدر أخدمك اليوم؟

messages.content: See vapi/system-prompt.md for the full, current system prompt (kept in one file so it's easy to diff/review). This assistant.json mirrors it verbatim when patched live via the Vapi Connect workflow.

function.name: find_customer
function.description: Look up an existing customer by phone or email before assuming they are a new customer. Call this near the start of the conversation once you have a phone number or email.

phone.description: Customer phone number in international format, e.g. +968XXXXXXXX

email.description: Customer email address, used only if phone is not available

function.name: create_customer
function.description: Create a new customer record. Use only after find_customer confirmed no existing record.

function.name: update_customer
function.description: Update an existing customer's record with new information gathered during the call. Use only after find_customer confirmed an existing record.

function.name: create_quote_request
function.description: Log a shipment quote request with whatever cargo/shipping details the customer provided. Creates the customer record if they are new.

function.name: get_available_slots
function.description: Get a few real open meeting slots from the calendar to offer the customer, instead of asking them to guess a time. Call this when the customer wants to book a meeting but hasn't proposed a specific time, or after a proposed time turned out unavailable.

function.name: create_meeting
function.description: Check calendar availability and book a real meeting. Only tell the customer it is booked after this tool reports success (result starting with 'meeting_booked'). If it reports 'slot_not_available_not_booked', do not claim it is booked.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-08-15T10:00:00+04:00

function.name: get_customer_history
function.description: Retrieve a short summary of this customer's past calls so you do not ask them to repeat themselves. Call this after find_customer confirms an existing record.

function.name: get_tracking_status
function.description: Save a shipment number the customer gives you. There is no live tracking source connected, so this only saves the number - never state a tracking location or delivery status to the customer.

function.name: get_business_status
function.description: Check whether Etihad One is currently open for business (Sun-Thu, 09:00-17:00 Asia/Muscat) before promising a callback time or telling the customer someone will reach them right away. Takes no parameters.

function.name: estimate_sea_freight_price
function.description: Calculate a rough approximate sea-freight price from cargo dimensions and declared goods value. Returns only a single rounded approximate total price - the pricing formula and any breakdown are never included in the result and must never be disclosed to the customer.

quantity.description: Number of pieces with these dimensions, default 1

goods_value_omr.description: Declared value of the goods in Omani Rial

destinations.message: بحوّلك الآن لأحد أعضاء فريقنا، لحظة من فضلك.
destinations.description: Transfer live to the human team for any escalation: explicit human request, complaints, legal/customs disputes, payment or compensation claims, lost or damaged shipments, sensitive negotiations, or anything the assistant cannot resolve confidently. Only for what tools genuinely cannot do - never a substitute for find_customer / get_available_slots / get_customer_history / get_tracking_status.

_server_note: This assistant-level server receives call lifecycle events (end-of-call-report, status-update). It must point at the Etihad One - Post Call n8n workflow. Tool calls use each tool's own 'server' block above, pointing at Etihad One - Tools Router. The transferCall tool needs no server block - it's a native Vapi telephony action.
_startSpeakingPlan_note: Tuned 2026-08-24 for natural human-paced response latency (was feeling sluggish): waitSeconds 0.6->0.4 (base pause after the customer stops talking before the assistant begins responding), onNoPunctuationSeconds 1.3->0.8 (how long to wait for more speech when the transcript doesn't end in clear punctuation - Arabic speech often doesn't, so this was the main source of perceived lag), onNumberSeconds 2.5->1.5 (still enough room to finish reading out a phone/tracking number without cutting it off, just not as long a hold).
_stopSpeakingPlan_note: numWords/voiceSeconds unchanged - still stops instantly on a single quiet interruption word (e.g. لحظة/wait), verified working. backoffSeconds lowered from 1.5 to 0.8 on 2026-08-24: at the very high interruption sensitivity set here, a 1.5s backoff after any detected interruption (including background noise/breath false positives) was compounding into the reported sluggishness - 0.8s still gives the customer real room before the assistant resumes, without stacking as much delay on a false trigger.

analysisPlan.summaryPrompt: Summarize this logistics call in 2-3 sentences in the language the customer used: who the customer is, what they needed (quote, tracking, meeting, question, complaint), and the outcome.
analysisPlan.structuredDataPrompt: Extract structured data about this call for the CRM.

human_required.description: True if this call needed human follow-up or was transferred, per the escalation rules in the system prompt

analysisPlan.successEvaluationPrompt: Did Etihad One correctly understand the customer's request, take the appropriate action (tool call), transfer to a human when escalation criteria were met, and avoid stating anything it could not verify (prices, dates, tracking status, booking success without confirmation)?
